tasks.label: summarize-volume-diag-results
args: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='logs/volume_diagnostic_30d.json';const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));const rows=j.allRows||[];const sy=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.symbol))];const pf=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.profile))];const best=sy.map(s=>{const r=rows.filter(x=>x.symbol===s);r.sort((a,b)=>b.profitFactor-a.profitFactor||b.expectancy-a.expectancy||b.winRate-a.winRate);const b=r[0];const base=r.find(x=>x.profile==='baseline_v1.04');return {symbol:s,bestProfile:b.profile,bestPF:b.profitFactor,bestWR:b.winRate,bestTrades:b.trades,baselinePF:base?.profitFactor,baselineWR:base?.winRate,deltaPF:base?Number((b.profitFactor-base.profitFactor).toFixed(2)):null,deltaWR:base?Number((b.winRate-base.winRate).toFixed(1)):null};});const agg=pf.map(name=>{const r=rows.filter(x=>x.profile===name);const t=r.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.trades,0);const w=t?r.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.winRate*x.trades,0)/t:0;const e=t?r.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.expectancy*x.trades,0)/t:0;const prof=r.filter(x=>x.profitFactor>=1.0).length;return {profile:name,totalTrades:t,weightedWinRate:Number(w.toFixed(1)),weightedExpectancy:Number(e.toFixed(2)),symbolsPFge1:prof};});console.log('BEST_JSON_START');console.log(JSON.stringify(best,null,2));console.log('BEST_JSON_END');console.log('AGG_JSON_START');console.log(JSON.stringify(agg,null,2));console.log('AGG_JSON_END');"
